scaleBeatText: A woman, maybe 20s walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A man, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut walks away from Haven. They don't look back.

With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Thornfield's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.
With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 11,250 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.

With Haven grieving again, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 11,250 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.
🗣️ Meera to Jesse, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

With Haven grieving again, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 11,250 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.
🗣️ Vasyl to Jesse, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"
Word comes: Thornfield's speaker is dead. In the chaos, Haven renegotiates — tribute down to 8,438 kcal/week. The link holds: it was never with one person. They grieve; the gains wait.

doorOffer.promptHtml: The ring of pale light. The too-many-angled faces. The trillions of eyes. The ring waits. Seven doors — some open, some priced beyond you. The choice is which risk you take. ◈ the Feared — 29 distinct monsters faced blow-by-blow. The footage exists, and it plays unasked. (standing: 96) ◇ the Indispensable — The Indispensable needs a full seat — the galaxy must actually need you, not just notice you. ◈ the Beloved — Viewership 33, fan favor 39 — the galaxy's favorite, by the numbers. (standing: 96) ◈ the Witness — 11 exposures on the record. The docket is real. (standing: 96) ◈ the Assimilated — Always open. The table takes anyone — that's what makes it a trap, and what makes it safe. (standing: 46) ◈ the Defiant — Defiance 6 on the record. The 'no' is earned. (standing: 40) ◈ the Relay —
